# Should we measure what to do when more environments are added to Legged Gym or Horovod does not speed up with multi-GPU?

> **Current answer:** Do not only look at num_envs: record the number of simulation steps per second, policy update time, VRAM, GPU utilization, and cross-GPU synchronization time, and ensure that the batch/mini-batch ratio is comparable.
